notes.title: Logicircuit release update!
notes.notes:
Update 1.0.0 brings a tutorial, which can be viewed in the main menu, and when you save but forget to enter a name, it will use the current time as a name.

More updates are to come, including a better way to manage saves.

notes.title: Update 0.2.0 - MultiConnect
notes.notes:
Hello Circuit Builders, Update 0.2.0 has been released, which includes a convenient feature, multi-connect! 

[h3]This Update Includes: [/h3]
[list]
[*]  Added multi-connect!
[*]  Updated UI
[*]  Improved selection
[*]  Added an indicator on the block you are connecting from
[*]  Many internal changes
[*]  Added a properties menu for blocks
[*]  Fixed bugs regarding selection
[*]  Control changes
[/list]

Some things in this update are still a work in progress and will be fixed in an upcoming patch.

The Demo is planned to come out either Feb. 6th or Feb. 13th so stay tuned!

notes.title: Beta Update! v0.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello circuit builders!

Today the new update marking the start of Beta has been released!

[h3]This update includes:[/h3]
 [list]
[*]Custom key bindings
[*]The ability to paint blocks with 8 different colors
[*]RGB lights now show the number of each input
[*]RGB lights can now be hooked up to each other to transfer colors
[*]UI improvements
[*]Added an inventory
[*]All new color scheme and textures
[*]The long awaited feature: Integrated Circuits!
[*]Many bug fixes
[/list]
[h2]Integrated Circuits[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43053779/55e761fe8758b5d22b051efe619bd90d7b87ec09.png[/img]

Ever wanted to compress your circuits into one block? With integrated circuits you can now do that! When you interact with the block you get teleported inside it and can build any circuit inside. This allows circuits to be more modular and compact which helps a lot in circuit building!

[h2]Inventory[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43053779/65307450d614719f36aa9aa87bb9e487a66165dd.png[/img]

The inventory is the place where Integrated Circuits can be selected and created. Additionally it has the controls for choosing a paint color, and also the settings for Integrated Circuits. At the bottom left are controls for increasing and decreasing the amount of outputs for the chip, and also where to name it and save it.

[h2]Visual Changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43053779/aefeced9732d67c001847339add25984547209bf.png[/img]

The game definitely needed a new look, so it has a brand new color scheme now! This transition is not fully complete but will be mostly complete by the next patch.

[h2]Painting[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43053779/a75d3e130fa902fa9d37da54f4d00a27d43fd907.png[/img]

Circuits should be organized, that is why painting is in this update. When every block looks the same there is a need to distinguish between different circuits and parts of circuits, so painting has been added. There are 8 different colors including the default, which can be chosen from the inventory.

[h2]Custom Key Bindings[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43053779/ab51a1ba2f649707c08dfa03f61e9f67bf23fd4a.png[/img]

Keys can now be rebound in order to customize the gameplay to your liking.

[h2]RGB Light Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43053779/81f8911a732ce4fb388d7b4a38e075b96e7d81fc.png[/img]

RGB lights can now be hooked into each other, when they are they will display the same color. Additionally, each light shows which input is which, so there is no confusion on which input controls which color.

A patch will come within the next week due to some features not being complete and some having bugs.

Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Beta Release in November
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome to LogiCircuit![/h2]

By November version 0.1.0 will be released, officially marking the beta release for testers. This update will include multi-connect, a tutorial, and componentization. There will also be visual changes included in this update, I have gathered feedback so the color scheme is going to be changing, example shown:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43053779/da498eadd7699ed02b69daec417082b47515c05c.png[/img]

I can wait to move forward and gain more feedback so I can improve the game and make it more fun for you all!
